source_caption_text:
This was really the golden era for everything 😭💯

🎶 Honestav - IPhone K*lled the MP3 

It’s 2005. Your PS2 has GTA: San Andreas in it, your favorite songs are on a burned CD, and picking your MySpace profile song feels like a major life decision 😭🎮💿

50 Cent’s “The Massacre,” Kanye’s “Late Registration” and Lil Wayne’s “Tha Carter II” were giving us new music, while “Hollaback Girl,” “Gold Digger” and “We Belong Together” were everywhere 🔥

You were playing Tony Hawk’s Underground 2, racing your friends in Need for Speed: Most Wanted or trying to convince your parents you needed a PSP. Then the Xbox 360 arrived and suddenly everybody wanted one 😂

Friday nights meant a trip to Blockbuster, flip phones snapped shut after a call, and you had to be careful not to use all your texts before the month ended 📱😭

We didn’t know we’d miss those ordinary days this much ❤️

What’s the first thing you think of when you hear “2005”? 👀👇
